truthNotes: Construction faithful to the upright reference: about 7 emerald-green ovals in 4 claws, alternating either side of one scalloped clear pavé S-wave; open back with two looped tips and a gap; cool silver tone; true contact shadow.
Oval / inner opening 0.19 (brief asked 0.25-0.35 from 5 / 16.5 mm; the upright reference itself measures 0.19).
The ring is turned about 50 degrees, so it is 0.68 as wide as tall and spans 45% of the width.
Headroom: the ring's top arc sits 79 px from the top of the Feed; that is the most this picture allows (P 100).
